description_excerpt: About the Role: The Data Privacy Officer / Legal Counsel is responsible for overseeing data privacy compliance across DKSH entities in Vietnam and contributing to the execution of the Group Data Privacy Program, ensuring alignment with applicable Vietnamese personal data protection laws, relevant international privacy standards, and the European Union General Data Protection Regulation (EU GDPR) where applicable. This role serves as the primary point of contact for privacy governance, regulatory engagement, and strategic privacy initiatives that protect the organization and strengthen trust…
